title: FBI-UAP-D025, Digital Rendering, “Airborne Triangle,” 2002
summary: This image is an artistic interpretation of a reported incident above Bagram Air Force Base, Afghanistan, potentially involving unidentified anomalous phenomena (UAP) in June 2002. This image is based upon a first-hand description provided by a former military service member, as described in FBI-UAP-D024. The Federal Bureau of Investigation prepared this digital rendering as a visual aid in 2026 in support of the PURSUE initiative.
image_alt_text: A digital rendering of a large, dark triangle against a starry night sky.
